source_contract_topics: Brownfield Land Registers and Permission in Principle
Tree Preservation Orders and conservation-area trees
Groundwater Source Protection and Safeguard Zones
Nitrate Vulnerable Zones and Farming Rules for Water
Shoreline Management Plans and coastal erosion

source_contract_findings.brownfield_pip: Part 1 and Part 2 brownfield-register entries, Permission in Principle, Technical Details Consent, the national data standard and a current local-register example were separated. Register presence was not treated as full planning permission, title, viability, funding or implementation.
source_contract_findings.heritage: The NHLE, listed-building grades, Listed Building Consent, Scheduled Monument Consent and Heritage at Risk evidence were separated. Designation and risk status were not treated as consent, planning permission, title, public access, structural condition or automatic refusal.
source_contract_findings.tpo: TPO categories, written-consent applications, conservation-area section 211 notices, exceptions and appeals were separated. A conservation-area location, notice, portal submission or web map was not treated as a final consent or exact protected-tree boundary.
source_contract_findings.groundwater: SPZ1, SPZ2 and SPZ3, groundwater safeguard zones, action-plan mapping and Environment Agency position statements were separated. Zone geometry was not treated as measured contamination, drinking-water quality, title, permit, completed mitigation or a planning outcome.
source_contract_findings.nvz: The 2025-2028 NVZ designation, whole-field boundaries, nitrogen-use and manure-storage rules and Farming Rules for Water were separated. Regulatory geography and duties were not treated as measured nitrate concentration, current compliance, title, liability or development suitability.
source_contract_findings.coastal: The 20 Shoreline Management Plans, four management approaches, 2055 and 2105 NCERM scenarios and Coastal Change Management Area evidence were separated. Strategy and projections were not treated as funded defence, exact erosion date, title, valuation, guaranteed land loss or planning permission.
